_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/ap.jsx APCreditDebit (L321-382) + CNDNForm (L486-518). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same PHRASES pattern as ap/billing-strings.json + ap/ap-deposit-strings.json. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, baht U+0E3F, em-dash never used here). kpiCnSubSuffix/kpiDnSubSuffix are the money-suffix tail of the prototype KPI sub ('-32,700 ฿ · ลดหนี้') — the signed amount is prepended in the view. Values already in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in phrases -> they render honest Thai (th, tp() returns the key itself) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are flagged for the sacred i18n round (agents/orch-b-recon/ap-cn-dn-i18n.apply.json, wei-approved:B-250). Status labels (approved/pending/draft) + cancel reuse existing DICT keys (fin.statusApproved/Pending/Draft, common.cancel) via t(), NOT this file. The prototype's read-only note-no + date fields and its mock submit toast are DROPPED (§0 rule 3: server owns the note `no`/date; a note posts its JV only on approve — never fabricated).
